head: 6c64d623
gate: Inline CDS UpstreamTlsContext decoding with TLS version policy and TLS endpoint publication
notes: CDS transport_socket accepts one inline UpstreamTlsContext with optional SNI, inline trusted_ca, one inline client certificate/key, Envoy TlsProtocol minimum/maximum versions (AUTO defaults to TLS 1.2/1.3; TLS 1.0/1.1 rejected) and a TLS 1.2 OpenSSL cipher-suite allowlist for the supported ECDHE GCM/ChaCha suites. The SNI and cipher-suite list are copied into owned material storage so a retained projection does not depend on the CDS resource arena. EDS, STATIC and DNS endpoints use TLS targets; EDS/STATIC project through the existing priority/locality runtime, DNS builds tls_host endpoints. The end-to-end test performs a certificate-verified RPC through a STATIC cluster using the inline CA. SDS, providers, ECDH curve lists, SAN matching and file/environment data sources are rejected.
